idea: A consultant portfolio with a booking CTA
outcome: Mobile navigation and the configured booking link work

idea: A product waitlist with referral sources
outcome: Owner retrieves one persisted signup with its original referral after duplicate submission
A keyboard user follows the configured ticket CTA
A failed save shows an error and does not claim signup success
Owner can retrieve the saved enquiry; another visitor cannot read it
Sign up, recover access, save a note and reopen it after reload; another user cannot read it
A customer record can be saved and updated without losing unrelated records
Server-dated check-ins generate correct consecutive-day streaks without duplicate credit

idea: Book a yoga class with two places
outcome: Concurrent requests cannot book a third place; cancellation frees capacity
Availability and cancellation work across Lima and London time zones

idea: Weekly sales totals from a CSV
outcome: Known amounts match totals before and after date filtering and reload
Category filters use saved rows and return known subtotals
Manual values persist and sample data never contributes to live totals
CSV preview catches malformed dates and duplicate record IDs before saving
Another account cannot read imported customer records
A Stripe test payment creates one paid order using server prices
Concurrent checkouts cannot sell the final item twice

idea: A stationery store with domestic shipping
outcome: Configured shipping destinations and flat shipping prices apply at checkout
Abandoned checkout releases stock only once after confirmed expiration
Refunds reconcile money correctly and do not pretend goods were returned
Test subscription activates private records only after verified payment
Cancellation preserves access until the configured paid period ends
Payment failure updates access according to the visible policy
Customer billing portal opens for the correct app customer only
Duplicate and reordered billing events cannot grant the wrong entitlement
Invited staff find a record and save its new status; history identifies the actor
A revoked staff member cannot retain read or write access
A CSV export contains the permitted saved records and escapes spreadsheet formulas
Staff cannot invite other owners or access another app's records
Edits, retesting, publishing and source restore preserve saved requests
